text:
maya: Quick heads-up — marketing flipped a last-minute APAC promo for next Tue-Fri. Early signals +20% inference QPS in apac-1 and apac-2 for peak hours. Can we do a quick capacity sync?
alex: On it. Do we have the projected GPU-hours bump number?
maya: From rough sim: ~3.6k extra GPU-hours over 72h if we keep current batching/seq lengths. That assumes current mix (gen-heavy).
chen: That matches what my load-tests showed when we increased prompt length. APAC p50 latency will degrade without changes.
laura: Also seeing higher egress from apac-2 -> eu-west gateway, some retries. Ops flagged 502s earlier today. Might reduce effective throughput.
sam: Ops-bot just posted the cluster health alert at 09:12: `ops-bot: [ALERT] apac-2 egress congestion 502s x5m`
ops-bot: link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/8234 (automated)
alex: Proposed mitigations: 1) pre-warm 48 A100-equivalent GPUs in apac-dedicated pool (72h reservation), 2) enable burst routing to us-west as fallback for non-low-latency routes, 3) shift non-urgent batch evals to off-peak.
chen: We should also push a quantization profile for the gen models in apac (int8-q) — estimated 30% GPU-hour saving but need a quick smoke test.
laura: For the egress, ops: can we route model downloads/cache refresh through eu-edge mirror to reduce apac->eu hops?
sam: network team suggested short-term NAT scaling, but that's slow. I'll open a ticket to add eu-edge mirror and flip cache preference TTL to 6h.
maya: Cost ask: any back-of-envelope on incremental spend for pre-warming + burst data? Need to tell finance.
finance-bot: rough estimate: 48 GPUs * 72h = 3456 GPU-hours. At $2.8/GPU-hour (reserved-burst blended) -> ~$9.7k. Additional egress/burst networking ~ $2.5k. Total ~ $12.2k. (very rough)
alex: Good enough for the exec update. Action items: (A) chen to run int8 smoke in staging and validate quality degradation within 2% BLEU/ROUGE or llm-eval thresholds; (B) sam to request apac-dedicated pre-warm and NAT scaling; (C) laura to coordinate eu-edge mirror config; (D) maya to sign off on reserve purchase after we confirm smoke.
chen: Starting smoke now. Using command: `rgpu simulate --cluster=apac-1 --model=redwood-gen-7b --quant=int8 --duration=30m`
chen: Quick note — if quant smoke passes, we can reduce pre-warm to 36 GPUs and still hit p95 targets during peak. That'd cut cost by ~25%.
maya: If that's the case, let's wait for the smoke (deadline 14:00) then finalize purchase.
sam: Ticket created: INFRA-7291 — pre-warm request + NAT escala. ETA for pre-warm activation: 3h after approval.
laura: I've changed cache TTL to 6h and flipped preference for eu-edge mirror in staging; will roll to prod once sam confirms NAT changes.
alex: Also small tweak: enable request-level short-circuit caching for repeated prefixes (15s TTL) during promo windows to shave extra tokens. Could shave another ~8% GPU-hours.
maya: Nice. Can someone sanity-check the math for final ask? If int8 passes + short-circuit caching + 36 GPU pre-warm we should be ~ -10% from our worst-case 3.6k -> ~3.2k GPU-hours extra, cost nearer $8.8k.
finance-bot: updated estimate if quant + caching + reduced pre-warm: compute ~ 2520 GPU-hours -> $7.1k, plus net ~ $1.7k = $8.8k.
chen: Smoke complete: quality delta 0.9% on eval set, latency p95 improved ~12% with int8. Marking pass.
maya: Ok I sign off on 36 GPU pre-warm for 72h. alex, sam — proceed.
sam: On it. I'll also enable routing policy: prefer apac-local -> eu-edge mirror -> us-west fallback (in that order).
alex: I'll update the weekly forecast deck with the numbers + contingency plan and note the promo window.
laura: Monitoring dashboards: added an APAC promo panel and 1-min burn alerts. Alert thresholds: +15% above baseline for 5m -> page oncall.
maya: Thanks team. Post-updates: drop a short note in #product and #sales so they can adjust customer expectations. :thumbsup:
alex: Will do. Closing loop in ~4h with a final readout.
maya: 👍
